[{"insert":"Suitcase Walking Lunge

The suitcase walking lunge alternates with the front rack split squat across this cycle. A heavy dumbbell in each hand loads the legs while adding a grip and core demand through the walk. Take controlled steps and keep the torso tall, using straps if grip fails before the legs do. Reps drop from Week 2 on this variation, so the weight goes up.
"}]
